info.title: iPago API
info.description: The public iPago API: the Developer API, the Storefront API and the Game API. Generated from the API's own OpenAPI document. Reference: https://docs.ipago.io/dev/reference

tags.name: Products and categories
tags.description: Read the products and categories of the store your API key belongs to.

tags.name: Checkouts
tags.description: Create a hosted checkout session for one or more products.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: List and retrieve the orders placed in your store.

tags.name: Refunds
tags.description: Refund a paid order and follow the refund's status.

tags.name: Disputes
tags.description: Read chargebacks raised against your orders.

tags.name: Balance and payouts
tags.description: Current ledger routes: /v1/balance, /v1/ledger_entries, and /v1/payouts. Paths and field names stay until the ledger change. Supplier settlement is the weekly purchase invoice.

tags.name: Deliveries
tags.description: Read the fulfilment tasks created for paid orders and report their outcome.

tags.name: Webhook endpoints and events
tags.description: Register the URLs iPago sends events to, send a test event, and read past events.

tags.name: Storefront
tags.description: Public, read-only view of a live store: its settings, categories and products.

tags.name: Baskets
tags.description: Build a basket, apply a coupon or gift card, and turn it into a hosted checkout.

tags.name: Game API
tags.description: The delivery queue a game server plugin polls, authenticated by a per-server token.
